title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: which signed amendments are chargeable
content:
## Rule
For the amendment fee under the Dangerous Goods Acceptance product, the signed amendments counted are the acceptance's declaration submissions whose type is amendment and whose outcome is signed; declarations awaiting the shipper's signature, returned for correction or withdrawn are never counted. Signed amendments are taken in the order in which they were signed: the first ones, up to the category's number of free amendments, are free, and every later one is chargeable. The number of chargeable amendments is therefore the number of signed amendments less the category's number of free amendments, never fewer than none.

## Free amendments per acceptance
| Category | Free amendments per acceptance |
|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 1 |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 1 |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 1 |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 0 |
| AHL DG Compressed Gases | 0 |
| AHL DG Special Approval | 0 |

## Which declarations enter the count
| Declaration on the acceptance's file | Counted as a signed amendment |
|---|---|
| amendment, outcome signed | yes |
| amendment awaiting the shipper's signature | no |
| amendment returned for correction | no |
| amendment withdrawn | no |
| initial declaration, any outcome | no |

## Worked cases (category figures from the table above)
| Category | Signed amendments | Less free amendments | Chargeable amendments |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL DG Limited Quantity | 3 | 3 less 1 | 2 — the second and third signed |
| AHL DG Class 9 Standard | 1 | 1 less 1 | none |
| AHL DG Toxics and Oxidizers | 2 | 2 less 0 | 2 — the first and second signed |
| AHL DG Flammables and Corrosives | 0 | 0 less 1 | none — never fewer than none |

## Points of judgement
- *Which amendment is the free one?* The earliest signed, up to the number of free amendments; the order is the order of signing.
- *Can the count of chargeable amendments fall below none?* No; where the free amendments exceed the signed amendments, there are no chargeable amendments.
